newsitem.title: POLAND: Two more firms underwrite Amerbank issue.
newsitem.headline: Two more firms underwrite Amerbank issue.

text.p: Polish oil and gas explorer Polskie Gornictwo Naftowe i Gazownictwo and MC Concordia Sp zoo will underwrite part of the 1.5-million-zloty share issue of Bank Amerykanski w Polsce SA (Amerbank), the bank said.

Amerbank said in a Thursday statement that Polskie Gornictwo would underwrite 340,000 shares and MC Concordia would underwrite 300,000 shares in the subscription set for between September 23 and September 27.
MC Concordia is part of MC European Capital Holdings, the European investment bank founded in 1994 and based in London and Geneva.
On Wednesday Polish Powszechny Bank Kredytowy SA (PBK) underwrote 700,000 shares and Bank Przemyslowo-Handlowy (BPH) underwrote 100,000 shares.
The new share issue at 21 zlotys per share will be valid if at least 600,000 shares are sold.
